name: WHY
description: Deterministic SAP Analytics Cloud variance signal analysis that compares period-aligned movement, groups overlapping evidence and ranks material signals by measured impact on the total rate. Includes data-driven YTD and period-range labeling, qualified dominant-driver logic, inspectable related views, native unit/currency inheritance, clickable period values and an executive multi-phase analysis experience. No AI, no backend, no telemetry, no writeback.

feeds.description: KPI Measures (one or more; selector appears when multiple are bound)
Time Dimension (Calendar Year, Year/Month, or Day for period-aligned YoY comparison)
Analysis Dimensions (bind one or more dimensions to scan for variance drivers)
